• 2-person capacity

• 2.1 kg packed weight

It's a straightforward shelter that does its job without unnecessary weight on your back. Not built for winter mountaineering, but for three seasons of backcountry use, it holds up.

Units are limited. If you've been thinking about it, order now before this restock sells out.
